headline: The federal government has declared Monday, November 9 a public holiday throughout the country for Allama Iqbal Day, according to a Cabinet Division notification issued on Thursday, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Cabinet Division ne poore mulk mein chutti ka elaan kar diya.

caption:
Monday, 9 November ko poore mulk mein aam chutti!
Dawn ke mutabiq Cabinet Division ne Thursday ko notification jari kiya ke Allama Iqbal Day par Monday, 9 November poore mulk mein public holiday hoga. Punjab ne bhi 9 November ki chutti ka elaan kiya hai aur State Bank of Pakistan bhi Monday ko band rahega.
Aap chutti ka din kaise guzarenge? Comment mein batayein 👇
